object.name: nodes
object.object_type: Node for person. Displayed information: - name - avatar - birth date (format is "1990", "февраль 1990" or "11 фев 1990" depending on known information) - death date (format is "1990", "февраль 1990" or "11 фев 1990" depending on known information) - gender (by color, see theme) On click: open person details panel
Node for marriage. Is displayed as a circle with heart icon. On click: nothing

object.name: edges
object.object_type: Edge for relation between marriage and a children of this marriage. Source is marriage node, target is person node. Edge is displayed as an animated line between marriage and person nodes.
Edge for relation between person and his/her marriage. Source is person node, target is marriage node. Edge is not displayed.

utility.name: normalizeTreeData
utility.desc: Нормализует данные дерева (draft/published) к единому формату nodes/edges для React Flow. Используется для унификации структуры дерева на фронте.

objects.object: Draft is a collection of unpublished changes in family tree. It contains: - new marriages - new persons - new positions for existing marriages and persons On view: - family tree is updated with the draft content - user can move persons nodes, create new marriages/persons On publish: - any unsaved position changes are automatically synced to ensure all layout changes are included - draft is published with api - left panel is updated from api so that it contains only unpublished drafts - family tree is updated from api with new content

layout.component: Drawer for user menu. Is located on the right side of the screen. Contains: - theme switcher - username of logged in user - user role (admin or user) - logout button (in the bottom of the drawer)

components.component:
Uses React Flow for rendering family tree with nodes and edges. Supports two modes: published (read-only) and draft (edit mode).
Click on person or marriage nodes to select them. Selected nodes are highlighted and show details in the side panel.
Double-click on person nodes to edit their information. Available only in draft mode.
Manual node positioning with drag and drop. Node movement is only allowed when a draft is selected in the draft panel. When no draft is selected, all nodes are fixed in their positions. When a draft is selected: - User can drag nodes according to the following rules: - unmarriaged person node (just this node is dragged) - marriage node (marriage node, both spouse and all the children nodes (with their spouses, marriages and children, etc.) are dragged) - Node positions are NOT automatically saved during drag operations - Positions are saved only manually via sync button or automatically every 20 seconds if changes exist
Position synchronization is handled by usePositionSync hook: - Manual sync via sync button in draft card (only enabled when unsaved changes exist) - Automatic sync every 20 seconds if there are unsaved changes - Visual indicators show sync status (warning color when unsaved, spinning icon when syncing)
Located in the right top corner of the screen, displayed only for admins. This button triggers edit mode: the draft panel is opened.

Located on the right side of the screen. Shows detailed information about the selected person.
Shows person's name, birth/death dates, relationships, and description. Includes photo if available.
Available only in draft mode. Allows editing person information through dialog.

Is located on the left side of the screen. Contains vertical layout for draft cards.
Located in the right top corner of the draft panel. This button closes the draft panel.
Draft card is a card representing a single draft for the family tree. Layout: - Draft name is centered at the top, full width, with a small edit icon next to it for renaming (intuitively grouped). - Delete (close) button is in the top-left corner of the card, styled as a cross (CloseButton). - Info button is in the top-right corner showing keyboard shortcuts. - Tools (add person, add marriage, sync positions) are arranged in a row below the name. - Publish button is full width, visually prominent, and labeled 'опубликовать'. On click: view draft
This button saves current node positions to the server. Only enabled when there are unsaved changes. Shows warning color when unsaved changes exist. Shows spinning animation when sync is in progress. Positions are also auto-synced every 20 seconds if changes exist.
This button triggers confirmation dialog. If user confirms, draft is published and removed from the draft panel. Before publishing, automatically syncs any unsaved position changes to ensure all layout changes are included in the published version.
This button triggers confirmation dialog. If user confirms, draft is deleted and removed from the draft panel.

Available only in draft mode: - Alt + P: Add person - Alt + M: Add marriage - E: Edit selected person - O: Organize marriage (align spouses) - R: Swap spouse positions - Delete/Backspace: Delete selected person/marriage

hooks.hook: Manages node position synchronization with the server. Features: - Tracks unsaved position changes - Manual sync via savePositions function - Automatic sync every 20 seconds if changes exist - Provides sync status (hasUnsavedChanges, isSyncing) - Debounced change detection to avoid excessive API calls
Handles node drag operations without automatic saving. Position saving is delegated to usePositionSync hook.
Handles marriage node organization (align spouses, swap positions). Position saving is delegated to usePositionSync hook.
